name: 6x18 surface grinder setup at a Portland hacker space

mentions.name: 6x18 surface grinder setup at a Portland hacker space
mentions.description: A donated 6x18 surface grinder with hydraulic x/y autofeed has been brought up and running at a Portland hacker space, including excavating the deep, older knowledge needed to go from no surface grinder experience to having the machine operational and usable.
mentions.problem: The hacker space has no floor space for the machine, and there was a steep learning curve going from knowing nothing about surface grinders to getting one operational.
mentions.source_excerpt: Got a donated 6x18 surface grinder with hydraulic x/y autofeed up and running at our Portland hacker space, but we have no floor space for it.
